baseBranchPatterns: NOTE: this list is replaced at run time. runai-actions .github/workflows/renovate.yml runs renovate/scan_candidates, which finds the newest release branches in this repository and starts one Renovate run per branch, each scoped to its own. This line is not a branch pattern and matches nothing.
includePaths: NOTE: the rest of this list is added at run time. runai-actions .github/workflows/renovate.yml runs renovate/scan_candidates, which adds every Go module it finds safe to bump. Keep only entries it cannot work out from the module layout, such as a folder holding no Go module. This line is not a path and is dropped before the list reaches Renovate.

packageRules.description: After a Go update, regenerate NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES in the same commit. This release branch has generate-licenses but not main's lib-generate, lib-manifests and lib-generate-mocks. The runai-actions pipeline takes these commands from the branch's own renovate.json, falling back to main's.
